# PR body — R6.17 (manifest 270 · HARBOR-O + REPROOF machinery)

## What

The O surface is now a pinned, recorded, read-only external tool, and the
$0 oracle re-proof is built — everything W1 (R6.32) needs so it only
executes the machinery:

- **The pin (REQ-XH-014, §5.9/Q-X41):** the dispatch live-read
  (`git ls-remote --tags + HEAD` on `harbor-framework/harbor`,
  2026-11-07T22:52Z; the ticket's one authorized network act) found no
  stable tag containing `skip_install` — newest tag `v0.25.0` =
  `fdba28fc`, `skip_install` landed `0a576fa5` a day later — so the
  recorded-default `commit_fallback` branch binds pin
  **`ff2a1ef48070a8df374669138e4d4db79b77f013`**. The pin record
  (`hh-harbor-pin/1`, committed instance under
  `tests/fixtures/r6_17/`) names the branch + live read; AR-04's record
  carries it by the dated amendment appended to ADR-0427; slot records
  carry it via `identity.harbor.pin` and `hh-harbor-trial/1` via
  `harbor_pin`. The E1 F13 diff obligation doesn't trigger (a commit,
  not a tag > v0.25.0).
- **Host venv (REQ-XC-315):** `hh-harbor-venv/1` — `uv sync --frozen`
  recipe; lock hash + resolved LiteLLM recorded at first build (W1 —
  pending honestly, the fetch is outside the authorized live-read);
  a differing fixture lock refuses.
- **Job config + ingest (REQ-XB-123):** `hh-harbor-job-config/1` with
  `max_retries=0` enforced and `--upload`/`--public` argv refused;
  read-only `jobs/<job>/` ingest → `hh-harbor-ingest/1` (per-file
  sha256 + blob-pool copies, committed config) + one
  `hh-harbor-trial/1` per trial (reward files, ctrf, test-stdout,
  exception, ATIF trajectory + version, pinned cause map). The tree is
  never mutated; infra causes keep the failed trial for a new-slot
  re-run.
- **Image identity (REQ-XB-124):** pull by digest → local tag →
  `--no-force-build` → post-job tag→digest assert; drift →
  `withheld{image_drift}` (R6.8's closed set); per-task tree digests vs
  `dataset.toml` refuse before any slot.
- **`skip_install` (REQ-XC-306):** at this pin the config carries
  `skip_install=true` + the layer digest; a pin without it labels every
  runner check `not-image-identical`.
- **Re-proof machinery (contributing REQ-XB-125/XH-116; REQ-XB-126/
  XH-027; REQ-XB-110 fault leg):** the observe → freeze → prove driver
  over O/H-pub/H-allow at R with the R/R admit rule; discordance
  classes `o_fail` (incl. `flaky`) → `oracle_fails_on_O{cause}`,
  `machinery` → repair never excluded, `allowlist_gap` →
  `allowlist_gap{host}`; append-only `hh-reproof-register/1`;
  `hh-reproof-packet/1` with the pinned phrase and `parity_admission`'s
  committed refusal `inauthentic_evidence{oracle_transport_equality}`;
  `live-executed` only with an `hh-live-evidence/1` ref — enforced in
  the codec *and* `check-live-evidence.sh`; the registered `reproof`
  live-verify leg (runs under R6.32 in W1).
